theme: The Denial Came First - Volume III
title: The Peers Said So
hook: Nobody asked. They answered three times.
stamp: The reassurance arrived before the question.

scenes.text: Assumir a presidência, por escolha dos próprios países participantes. We would like to confirm: it was by choice of the participating countries themselves.
In Portuguese. In English. In Spanish. The same line. Elected by his peers. No one had asked how the chair was chosen.
When the answer arrives before the question, and then arrives again in two more languages, the question was never the problem.
